text:
Jordan Kim: Hey team, first day here! Laptop arrived but Im stuck on SSH to the jumpbox: `Permission denied (publickey)`. Also where do I get a badge and whos my mentor? Fun fact: I collect vintage postcards  Priya Gomez: Welcome Jordan!! :tada: Mentor is Sam Williams. Badge pickup at HQ lobby 1000908 (bring photo ID) — if remote we can ship a temporary access sticker, DM me. Added you to #new-hires and #platform-intros.
Sam Williams: Hey Jordan, Im your mentor. For SSH try:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa jkim@jump.redwood.internal
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa && ssh -v jkim@jump.redwood.internal
```
If still fails, DM me the `ssh -v` output (censor hostnames). Ill also set up a 30m sync this week (async-friendly).
alex.dev: On mac, run `ls -la ~/.ssh` and ensure your `id_rsa.pub` is uploaded to GitLab (Profile > SSH Keys). Link: https://git.redwood/company. Also confirm `ssh-agent` has your key.
it-bot: Note: VPN requires MDM enrollment before allowing jumpbox access.
mdm-bot: To enroll: 1) Install CompanyMDM (mac pkg / Win exe) 2) Open app, sign with @redwood.com 3) Enter emailed code and accept prompts. Reply "enrolled" when finished.
Jordan Kim: Installing MDM now, running `ssh-add`. Quick question: Im in IST, overlap with US is limited — is async onboarding okay?
Sam Williams: Totally fine. Ill post notes/recordings and well do short overlap if needed.
Priya Gomez: Welcome lunch on Friday 12pm PT (optional)  we do a 5-min intro round.
Jordan Kim: Enrolled in MDM and re-ran `ssh -v`  still permission denied, sending output to Sam in a DM. Thanks all! 
alex.dev: If you still see issues, paste `ssh -v` output here (mask anything sensitive) and the exact key filename you uploaded to GitLab.
mdm-bot: Reminder: policies may take 5-10m to apply. If VPN still blocks after 15m open an IT ticket and include your device hostname.
Jordan Kim: Got it, thanks everyone. Also: vintage postcard trade incoming  will show at lunch :)
